movelist.name: Endure
movelist.effect: If the user is hit by a damaging Move, you may use Endure as a Free Action. If the Move would bring Endure’s user down to 0 Hit Points or less, Endure’s user instead is set to 1 Hit Point.

movelist.name: Mud Sport
movelist.effect: All targets in the burst, including the user, gain a Coat which grants them 1 Step of Resistance to Electric Type Moves. After a target has been hit by a damaging Electric Type Move, the coat is removed.

movelist.name: Powder Snow
movelist.effect: Powder Snow Freezes all Legal Targets on 19+.

movelist.name: Mud-Slap
movelist.effect: The target’s Accuracy is lowered by -1.

movelist.name: Mud Bomb
movelist.effect: The target’s Accuracy is lowered by -1 on 16+.

abilities.name: Pickup
abilities.effect: You may use Pickup as an Extended Action that requires at least 5 minutes. Roll 1d20, consult the Pickup keyword to figure out what you find!

abilities.name: Snow Cloak
abilities.effect: The user gains +1 Evasion. This is increased to +2 Evasion while in Hail or snowy terrain. While in Hail, the user and adjacent allies do not lose Hit Points due to the Hail.
